messages:
Maria CSM: Heads up — SolaceAI usage down ~65% last 30d. Champion Priya left 2w ago, new PM not responsive. Procurement looped in and mentioned a NebulaLabs pilot starting next week. Concerned this is a renewal risk.
Devin (AE): On my discovery call they said Nebula's pilot emphasizes cost & latency. Asked for perf numbers; they want a side‑by‑side.
Maria CSM: Uploaded quick deck + usage export here: https://redwood.internal/sales/solaceai/usage-30d.csv and screenshots of top queries. They mostly run "rtx-qa" with avg seq ~512.
Sophie - SE: I can run a micro benchmark and token-cost calc against Nebula's profile. Need sample payloads + confirmation of model variant. I can have results EOD Fri if we get data now.
Maria CSM: DMed payloads to Sophie. Also noted they're sensitive to cold-start latency for interactive flows.
Oliver (Director CS): Let's align on a 3-step salvage plan: 1) Engineering office hours with their new PM/CTO (Sophie + Devin) 2) Customized perf & cost brief (Sophie) 3) 30-day pilot with a dedicated SE + success check-ins. Approve if we include a 15% pilot discount? :thinking_face: 
Devin (AE): I'll flag to finance/sales for concession approval. Prefer we offer credits vs discount to preserve list price. :thumbsup: 
legal-ops: FYI we'd need a short amendment for credits. I can draft a T&Cs addendum once sales confirms structure.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled — SolaceAI perf sync with Redwood (Sophie, Devin, Maria) on Tue 10:00am PST.
Maria CSM: Can we also get a quick routing fallback configured during the pilot? Their traffic spikes unpredictably.
Sophie - SE: Yes — I can propose a batching/cache profile and a KV prefix cache for their top 5 endpoints. Will include config snippet and cost delta in the brief.
Devin (AE): I'll prep a one-pager comparing latency & cost assumptions vs Nebula for the pilot workload. Would like Sophie to validate numbers before I send to them.
Maria CSM: Action owners: Sophie (benchmarks & config) by Fri EOD; Devin (concession + one-pager) by Mon; Legal to draft amendment when Devin confirms. We'll reconvene after the Tue sync. Thanks all. :pray:
